note: Isometric café home, avatars in a cooking pose and board-matched pets, 18 Oct 2026. Test folder only.

assets.subject: an isometric 3D diorama of a small cosy café room, cut away to show the floor and two walls, in the same camera angle, layout, furniture, colours and soft 3D rendering style as the café in the attached picture
assets.details: Arched windows on the left wall; a pink booth bench and two small round wooden tables with pink chairs on the left; a long wooden service counter with a fluted front and a white top on the right, with a small stove and a black wok on it; three wooden bar stools in front of the counter; shelves with jars and a blank dark chalkboard on the back wall; a pastry display case at the right end of the counter; pendant lamps and many potted plants; peach-pink terracotta tiled floor. There are NO people and NO animals anywhere: the space behind the counter is empty, and a round pink floor cushion at the front of the floor is empty. The chalkboard is completely blank. Keep one clear empty spot of floor at the front-left corner. Ignore any words in the attached picture.

assets.subject: Wen, the same woman as in the first attached picture (same face, wavy shoulder-length brown hair, cream jumper and coral apron), as a café owner cooking
assets.details: Drawn in the soft 3D rendering style and adult proportions of the café owner in the second attached picture. Waist-up figure cut straight across at the waist, body turned slightly towards the viewer's left as in an isometric game, smiling at the viewer, both hands in front at waist height holding a small black wok and a wooden spatula. Just the figure: no counter, no furniture, no other objects.
